$comment:
Deliberately NOT covered by this schema (handled by spec-lint.mjs at runtime):
  1. summary-length: ≤25-word limit — JSON Schema has no word-count keyword.
  2. origin_decision_ref referential integrity: whether the value resolves to a real decision in a motive's Decision Log.
  3. superseded_by referential integrity: whether the target node exists.
  4. snapshot_of referential integrity: whether the referenced snapshot exists.
  5. parent-agrees-with-directory-path: N/A for requirements (no parent field), but concept agreement is not validated here.
  6. verify, ears, summary: stale frontmatter per RFC-0003 — spec-lint.mjs emits stale-frontmatter errors for these at runtime; they are kept as optional properties here so additionalProperties:false does not add a second error on top. The anyOf requiring ears-or-summary is removed for the same reason.
The origin_decision_ref 'null' sentinel (literal string "null") IS rejected here via not:{const:"null"}.

concept.description: Id of the parent concept node

pattern.description: EARS pattern classification; optional per D-24 (0/104 corpus files carry it)

verify.description: Stale frontmatter per RFC-0003 — kept optional so additionalProperties:false does not double-report alongside spec-lint stale-frontmatter check

origin_decision_ref.description: Decision ref that introduced this node, in the form <motive-slug>#D-<n> (e.g. plugin-cleanup#D-5); literal string 'null' is rejected here

ears.description: Stale frontmatter per RFC-0003 — kept optional so additionalProperties:false does not double-report alongside spec-lint stale-frontmatter check

summary.description: Stale frontmatter per RFC-0003 — kept optional so additionalProperties:false does not double-report alongside spec-lint stale-frontmatter check; ≤25 words enforced by spec-lint.mjs

date_updated.description: D-24 canonical field; ISO date of last update

design.description: D-24 canonical field; design reference or link
